verdict.rationale: Reducto's docs explicitly state Zero Data Retention (API data auto-deleted within 24h) for Growth-tier+ customers, plus completed SOC 2 Type I/II and a HIPAA-compliant pipeline with BAA availability for Growth/Enterprise tiers, and VPC-resident storage for enterprise deployments — directly matching the story's compliance requirements for contracts/medical records. missing for 10: independent third-party audit confirmation of SOC2/HIPAA claims, and the ZDR/HIPAA options are gated behind Growth/Enterprise tiers rather than available by default (community also notes DPA is enterprise-only)
